decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for take away(A5) purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times 11am to 11pm Monday to Sunday.
Condition : 4 - No deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of 11am and 11pm.

Condition : 5 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 6 - Before first occupation of the buildings the loading, unloading and turning space, and parking spaces (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing No KFC/2130/02, with the exception of a parking space in front of the premises which does not have a lawful access to the highway, and such spaces shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.
description: Change of use from solicitors office to hot food take away, including a flue to rear elevation of building.
